_help: Home-screen Merchant (Skillz, DESIGN.md §20). Sells rolled guns for Gravemarks. Read by scripts/merchant/merchant.gd. price_mult multiplies every price (featured included) after the rarity list price: Economy v2 (2026-10-20, Jason: ~50% cheaper for now) runs at 0.5; 1.0 restores the §20.7 list prices (13 / 28 / 63 / 154 / 315). Rerolls are not multiplied. stock_size 4..6 (clamped). slots[i] = rarity weights (common..mythic, relative) for stock slot i; slots past the end reuse the last entry. featured = that slot gets featured_bonus (extra IP, extra perk, price x price_mult). rarity.<id>: price in Gravemarks, item_power [min, max] rolled uniformly (passed to GearDB.roll_weapon, so it replaces the round-based drop IP), bonus_perks added on top of Rarity.PERK_SLOTS, roll_quality_floor = the gun is re-rolled (up to max_roll_attempts, deterministic, best kept) until its stat roll quality (0 worst .. 1 best) reaches this, playstyle_perks_min = at least this many perks flagged "playstyle": true in data/perks.json (a random non-playstyle perk is swapped; a Mythic's archetype perk is kept). mythic_signature_perks = ids of Mythic-only signature perks; a Mythic offer gets one of them, but only ids that exist in GearDB.perks count (MAIN_HOOKS §19c adds them and keeps them out of random drops). Retune 2026-10-19 (Jason: not too cheap, rewarding): prices ~1/2/4.5/11/22.5 Hard matches. Stock refreshes every refresh_seconds, aligned to multiples of refresh_seconds since the unix epoch (top of the hour). reroll_costs[n] = price of the (n+1)th paid reroll since the last free refresh; past the end, the last cost + reroll_cost_step per extra use. rollback_reanchor_seconds: if the clock goes back further than this behind last_seen_time, the stock is kept and the timer re-anchors to the corrected clock (no early refresh). income_source "armory" = matches_to_afford() uses Armory.matches_to_max(diff).per_match (Armory.expected_match_income at the typical round count); income_per_match is the fallback / documented snapshot. Maps map 1:1 to difficulty (arena=easy, rustwell_foundry=medium, lockout_substation=hard), so per-map income = per-difficulty income.
